name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-docs
title: Google Docs MCP
description: MCP server for the Google Docs API: read documents as text/Markdown, edit by ranges, style, tables, images, comments, export.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DOCS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DOCS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DOCS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Static OAuth2 access token (~1h lifetime) — alternative to the refresh-token trio, mostly for testing.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DOCS_DRIVE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Drive API root override (markdown import/export, document export, comments).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DOCS_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads).
